svg.title: Context scaling from 4K to 64K and subsystem speedups on Apple Silicon
svg.desc: Stock LiteRT-LM v0.18.0 drops from 43 tok/s at 4K to 27 tok/s at 32K and caps at 32K; Agello sustains 57.8 tok/s Chat and up to 84.3 tok/s Rewrite at 64K with 12/12 bit-exact copies to position 65,534. Subsystem speedups: 7.6x faster warm 64K load, 4.5x faster Vision ViT encode, 2.2x faster 40-page PDF ANE index, 1.4x faster prefill, and zero host logit readbacks.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SILICON BENCHMARKS · IPHONE 17 PRO · APPLE A19 PRO, 12 GB · IOS 27.2.1
